channel.title: Forza Horizon 6 Guide — Horizon Japan
channel.description: Forza Horizon 6 lands in a fictionalised Japan with the biggest map the series has ever built and 550+ cars. This guide covers the car list, barn finds, treasure cars, the Estate, the interactive Japan map, and a beginner path to Horizon Legend — with sources noted for everything.

item.title: Cars — list, best picks, aftermarket, Forza Edition, treasure & barn finds
item.description: Forza Horizon 6 launches with 550+ cars [WIKI]. The first group lists vehicles confirmed directly by Wikipedia (key-art cover car and the cross-title loyalty rewards). The remaining groups are drawn from community guides (IGN, GamesRadar, Reddit) and are clearly marked as community-sourced.

item.title: Houses & Property — plus the interactive garage map & tracker
item.description: Forza Horizon 6 scatters 8 player houses across Japan, and each comes with a permanent perk that stays active no matter where you spawn. The headline is The Estate (Yashiki House) — a fully buildable plot you shape with an upgraded EventLab toolset. Houses unlock through the Discover Japan Stamp system (yellow → green → blue → orange → gold). Heads-up: the game also has 8 separate Garages (fast-travel + car-display points) — a different set of "8", not the houses. [RPS, TECH, FH6GUIDE]

item.title: FAQ — release, platforms, cars, garages & the Estate
item.description: Straight answers on platforms, the PS5 version, Game Pass, PC specs, cars, garages, houses and progression — only from sourced, confirmed information.

item.title: Festival Playlist Tracker — seasons & rewards
item.description: The Festival Playlist is the live content backbone of every Forza Horizon. A new season drops each week across a four-week Series; each season hands out exclusive cars, credits and accolades. Track your own progress below — we never list rewards we can't verify.

item.title: Beginner's Guide — Path to Horizon Legend
item.description: New to Horizon Japan? Follow this path — distilled from the Reddit no-spoiler guide, RedBull tips, Polygon's 10 tips, and the official First Drive, cross-checked against Wikipedia's confirmed systems.

item.title: Interactive Map — Regions of Japan
item.description: Forza Horizon 6 is set in a fictionalised Japan with the largest open-world map in the series [WIKI]. The areas below are named in Wikipedia; community guides report the full map spans 10 regions — we list what is encyclopaedically confirmed and clearly mark the rest.
